children: Donegal Mutual Insurance Co, a 10% Owner, reported two direct purchases of Class A Common Stock on 2026-09-11. The transactions comprised 9,725 shares at $19.254 and 45,000 shares at $19.226, for a weighted average price of $19.234 per share. The combined purchase amount was $1,052,415. Following the reported transactions, Donegal Mutual Insurance Co directly owns 14,387,128 Class A Common Stock and 4,751,974 Class B Common Stock.
